title: Towards an Effective and Efficient Deep Learning Model for COVID-19 Patterns Detection in X-ray Images
summary: Primary journal article and arXiv v1 report deep-learning COVID-19 X-ray classification on a small, imbalanced dataset with a five-patient held-out test set; authors caution that broader heterogeneous validation is needed before clinical use.
